核心特性

为什么选择 Summarizer

✓

零遗漏概括

逐段提取所有关键要点，输出前交叉验证完整性，确保不丢失任何重要信息。

123

数据保真

保留具体数字、名称、日期和阈值，不四舍五入或丢弃关键数据。

＝

多语言支持

自动匹配源文本语言输出。中文输入输出中文，英文输入输出英文。

⚙

自适应结构

长文本自动分组加标题，短文本使用扁平列表，根据内容智能调整。

工作流程

四步完成精准概括

1

阅读理解

通读全文，识别主题、结构和所有关键信息

→
2

提取要点

逐段提取每个独立观点、事实、数据和行动项

→
3

组织精简

按逻辑分组，裁剪冗余，每条要点独立完整

→
4

质量检查

交叉验证无遗漏、无冗余、可独立理解

在线体验

粘贴文本或上传文件，即时获取要点概括 — 无需下载、无需跳转

📄

点击选择文件或拖拽到此处

支持 .txt 和 .md 文件，最大 500KB

AI 增强

AI 增强模式使用 OpenAI API 进行抽象式概括，效果更接近原生 Skill。
API Key 仅保存在浏览器 localStorage 中，不会发送到任何第三方服务器。

输入 — 英文新闻

The company announced its Q3 results today. Revenue reached $12.4 million, up 23% year-over-year, driven primarily by enterprise subscriptions which grew 41%. However, the consumer segment declined 8% due to increased competition. CEO Jane Doe stated that the company will launch a new mobile app in Q4 to address the consumer decline. The board approved a $5 million share buyback program. Operating margins improved to 22% from 18% last year.

输出 — 要点概括

  • Revenue reached $12.4M in Q3, up 23% YoY.
    • Enterprise subscriptions drove growth at +41%.
    • Consumer segment declined 8% due to competition.
  • CEO Jane Doe announced a new mobile app launching in Q4.
  • Board approved a $5M share buyback program.
  • Operating margins improved to 22% (from 18% last year).
Source: pasted text | Points: 5

输入 — 中文市场报告

2026年上半年，中国新能源汽车销量达到412万辆，同比增长38.7%。新能源汽车在整体汽车市场的渗透率已达到52.3%，首次超过传统燃油车。其中纯电动汽车销量为268万辆，占比65%；插电式混合动力销量为144万辆，占比35%。比亚迪继续领跑市场，上半年销量为128万辆，市场份额31.1%。特斯拉中国销量为42万辆，市场份额10.2%。

输出 — 要点概括

  • 2026年上半年中国新能源汽车销量达412万辆，同比增长38.7%。
  • 新能源汽车渗透率达52.3%，首次超过传统燃油车。
    • 纯电动汽车销量268万辆，占比65%。
    • 插电式混合动力销量144万辆，占比35%。
  • 比亚迪领跑：销量128万辆，市场份额31.1%。
  • 特斯拉中国：销量42万辆，市场份额10.2%。
Source: pasted text | Points: 4

输入 — 技术文档

The API uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication. Requests must include a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Tokens expire after 3600 seconds and can be refreshed using the /oauth/refresh endpoint. Rate limiting is set to 1000 requests per hour per API key. All responses are in JSON format. Error codes follow HTTP standards: 400 for bad requests, 401 for unauthorized, 429 for rate limit exceeded, and 500 for server errors.

输出 — 要点概括

  • Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with Bearer tokens in the Authorization header.
  • Tokens expire after 3600 seconds; refresh via /oauth/refresh.
  • Rate limit: 1000 requests/hour per API key.
  • All responses are JSON.
  • Error codes: 400 (bad request), 401 (unauthorized), 429 (rate limit), 500 (server error).
Source: pasted text | Points: 5

输入 — 会议纪要（短文本）

We decided to move the authentication module to JWT-based tokens. Mike will handle the backend implementation by Friday. Lisa needs to update the test suite to cover the new token refresh flow. Tom will configure the CI/CD pipeline to inject the JWT secret as an environment variable. We also agreed to deprecate the old login endpoint by end of month.

输出 — 扁平列表

  • Decided to move authentication from session cookies to JWT-based tokens.
  • Mike will handle backend implementation by Friday.
  • Lisa needs to update the test suite for token refresh flow.
  • Tom will configure the CI/CD pipeline to inject JWT secret.
  • Agreed to deprecate the old login endpoint by end of month.
Source: pasted text | Points: 5

使用方法

快速上手 Summarizer

安装

# 将技能文件夹复制到技能目录 cp -r summarizer/ ~/.codex/skills/ # 验证安装 python quick_validate.py summarizer/

输出 Skill is valid! 即表示安装成功。

触发方式

  • 隐式触发 — 直接说"帮我概括一下这段内容"并粘贴文本
  • 显式触发 — 使用 $summarizer 前缀
  • 文件输入 — 提供路径，如"概括 article.txt 的内容"
  • 网页在线 — 直接在上方在线体验区操作
支持格式：粘贴文本 · .txt 文件 · .md 文件
